Archie on Your Phone

Your Agent, From Anywhere

Add add-ons, finish their setup, and pause routines without going back to your computer.

Checking your session…

This page is for your phone

It manages the Archie running on this computer from somewhere else. On this screen you already have the whole app, so there is nothing here you cannot do better in Archie itself.

To set it up: open Archie, go to Account, and turn on Archie on your phone. Scan the code it shows with your phone’s camera.

Pair this phone

Your agent lives on your computer, and only your computer can let this phone in. This takes about a minute, once.

  1. On your computer, open Archie.
  2. Go to Account.
  3. Turn on Archie on your phone.
  4. Point this phone’s camera at the code it shows, and tap the link.
On your home screen, a scanned code opens Safari rather than this app, so bring the link across instead. In Archie, under Account, tap Copy the link. If your computer is a Mac, that link is already on this phone’s clipboard.

The code carries the key that encrypts everything between the two devices. It is the reason we can run this without being able to read any of it.
